content.headline: Carpe Diem
copy: When you fly PLATOON; you have an aircraft at your sole disposal, allowing you to plan to the last detail and spend the day your way. Fly to the destinations you want, pick up a friend en route, and pack more in.

data.quote: From a warm welcome on take-off to a cheery ciao on landing, we want you to think of our jet as “your home in the sky”, where everything is designed to work around your comfort, your desires and your needs.

data.headline: Elevated dining
copy: From a light snack to a gourmet meal, PLATOON provides an exclusive range of menus to cater for any occasion. Tell us what you desire, and we’ll make it happen, simple.
